biotools.summary: AQuA2-Cloud is a portable, cloud-native web platform designed for performing advanced, multi-user spatiotemporal activity quantification from fluorescence bioimaging datasets. It improves upon existing tools by reducing software licensing requirements and centralizing analysis workflows.
biotools.name: AQuA2-Cloud: Web platform for fluorescence bioimaging activity analysis
